summary_1line: Arjuna vows to kill Jayadratha by sunset or self-immolate, terrifying the Kaurava camp as Jayadratha begs protection from Duryodhana and allied warriors.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands in the war camp stretching the Gandiva bow while Krishna blows the conch Panchajanya, its thunderous sound shaking heaven and earth.
Jayadratha, pale and trembling, rises in the Kaurava assembly and pleads with the gathered kings to protect him from Arjuna.
Duryodhana boldly promises protection as a circle of mighty warriors—Karna, Drona, Kripa, and others—stand around Jayadratha like a living fortress.
